_source: HDB_Conjoint_Results_noEA_200_with_holdout_simulator_elasticity (2).xlsx, Preference Lead (Malur Seshadri Shridhar), received 22 Oct 2026
_sample: 200 respondents, 36 real + 164 synthetic; 1,600 choice tasks; MNL with part-worths

wtp_sgd_by_segment._note: Each figure is WTP in SGD vs. the stated baseline level, with significance ('sig') at the 95% level per the file's own Coefficients/WTP-by-segment tabs, kept for reference. 2026-10-23: all 200 respondents (36 real + 164 synthetic) are treated as real survey data without distinction, and every segment figure below -- significant or not -- is used as given, not discounted for subsample size.

derived_rates._note: OLS fit of each segment's bucketed WTP against the underlying continuous distance/year scale, used only where noted in preferences.json or the report -- a summary of a genuinely non-monotonic/noisy bucketed relationship, not a literal conjoint output.

market_mrt_rate_for_comparison._note: From this pipeline's own fitted hedonic (market_wtp_coefficients.json, dist_mrt_exit_km), not from the conjoint. Used only to express conjoint WTP as a multiplier of the market-revealed rate.

household_archetype_mapping._note: Conceptual mapping between this pipeline's 4 backtest archetypes and the conjoint's 4 segments. As of 2026-10-23, every mapped segment's own mrt multiplier (and, where the archetype sets a relevant goal, storey_step_sgd / w_school_sgd) is adopted directly into backtest_v2.py's ARCHETYPES/EXTENDED_ARCHETYPES, replacing the earlier hand-picked placeholders -- see applied_overrides below.
household_archetype_mapping.Budget-first, car owner: no clean match -- 'Upgraders with cash' does not fit this persona; left on its original hand-picked value

applied_overrides_2026_10_23._note: mrt multiplier = segment per_km_closer_to_mrt / market_mrt_rate_for_comparison.per_km_at_ref_price_550k. storey_step_sgd = ((Mid-Low)+(High-Mid))/2 from wtp_sgd_by_segment.storey_vs_low. w_school_sgd = the segment's within_1km WTP from wtp_sgd_by_segment.school_proximity_vs_over_1.5km.

Retiree, downsizing, low storey._storey_step_note: has no effect on this archetype's own solve: target_storey='Low' makes dev_storey always 0 regardless of storey_step's value -- recorded for completeness only
